title: Crafting Fast, Practical Tools for Everyday Builders
subtitle: Toolify brings 100+ focused web utilities into one clean workspace—created and maintained by Kawsar to save time, reduce friction, and keep daily digital work effortless.
homePreviewCaption: Clean UI, EN / বাং support & fast utility access

storySection.title: Why Kawsar Built a Single Workspace for Everyday Tasks
paragraphs: Working on web apps, interfaces, and daily digital tasks often means jumping across slow, ad-heavy websites just to format text, check data, or run a quick utility. Toolify started with a simple goal: put 100+ practical tools inside one fast, distraction-free platform.
Every detail—from bilingual English & Bangla switching and dark/light themes to mobile-friendly layouts—is shaped by Kawsar with real-world developer and user workflows in mind.

pillarsHeading: What Shapes Every Tool on Toolify

craft.title: Thoughtful Engineering

accessibility.title: Bilingual & Adaptable
